description: rnews_main.rs:279 — trusted_keys: Arc::from(vec![]) allocates a fresh Arc-wrapped empty slice on every iteration of the article processing loop. At the 1000-article cap this is 1000 gratuitous heap allocations for an immutable empty sentinel. Fix: construct the empty Arc once before the loop (let empty_trusted_keys: Arc<[_]> = Arc::from(vec![]);) and clone it per iteration (clone of an Arc is a refcount bump, not a heap alloc). Impact at realistic scale: minor but pointless churn; easy one-liner fix.
title: Hoist Arc::from(vec![]) out of per-article loop
